Job Description
 We are searching for Senior Cloud Engineers to join our client's core DevOps team, aiming to build their AWS stack and foundation, using all the best practices.
 Main Responsabilities:
 Design and build reusable IaC modules (Terraform) 
 Implement the CI/CD pipelines in order to perform the tests and the deployment. 
 Review submitted merge requests related to CI/CD processes. 
 Contribute to CI/CD pipelines continuous improvement. 
 Ensure infrastructure auditability, security (policy-as-code) and observability. 
 Ability to work closely with your team members and the other development teams 
 Ability to deploy, run and monitor the applications, perform regular on call duty. 
 Job Requirements
 Strong hands-on experience with AWS Cloud (Well-Architected practices) 
 Experience running production workloads at scale, ideally on AWS 
 IaC: full proficiency in Terraform, Terragrunt and AWS CDK 
 OS: Linux and Windows; 
 Monitoring & logging: Grafana, Prometheus, Prometheus alertmanager, Dynatrace, PagerDuty 
 Frameworks & Technologies: GitLab (VCS, CI/CD), Github, Event driven architectures 
 Databases: NoSQL experience (DynamoDB..), PostgreSQL, MySQL, Opensearch / Elasticsearch, Aurora 
 FinOps experience (AWS Cost Explorer, Compute Optimizer) a plus 
 English mandatory, structured, analytical mindset, team Player, Communication, Familiar with Agile methods (SAFe, Scrum).
